_meta.datasheet_section: Figure 3 (Pin connection DFN-6, fixed version, top view) + Table 1 (Pin description)
_meta.notes: Fixed-variant pinout per ST datasheet visual diagram. The SamacSys symbol carries 'ADJ' as the pin-3 label because it's shared across the adj + fixed family, but for fixed-output variants (PV33R, PV18R) the datasheet diagram explicitly labels pin 3 as NC. We follow the datasheet.

pins.name: EN
pins.note: Logic input: low=shutdown, high=active. DO NOT FLOAT (per Table 1). Abs-max per DS Table 5 EN pin.

pins.name: NC
pins.note: On the adjustable variant this pin is ADJ; on the FIXED variants (PV33R) the datasheet diagram labels it NC. SamacSys family symbol exposes the adjustable label.

pins.name: VIN
pins.note: 1.6 V to 5.5 V input per datasheet Table 5 (operating range).

pins.name: EP
pins.note: Exposed pad — Table 1: 'Must be connected to GND'. Required for thermal.
